item.title: Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority wins 1st place at EMS World Clinical Challenge 2026 in US
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority secured first place and the gold medal at the EMS World Clinical Challenge 2026, held during the 38th edition of EMS World Expo 2026

item.title: Rabdan Security and Defence Institute to host Middle East Defence Conference 2026 in emirate
item.description: The Rabdan Security and Defence Institute (RSDI), Rabdan Academy's think tank specialising in security and defence studies, has announced that it will host the Middle East Defence Conference 2026 on 19 November 2026, at Rabdan Academy in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: During official visit to Greece, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi visits Technical Training and Qualification Center and meets Emirati military students
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, has visited the Technical Training and Qualification Center in Greece, which specialises in training and preparing military personnel across various technical fields.

item.title: Abu Dhabi Police enhances Captain Sanad’s capabilities with AI to strengthen communication and public awareness
item.description: Abu Dhabi Police General Headquarters has enhanced the capabilities of its virtual character, Captain Sanad, by introducing new media and interactive functions powered by artificial intelligence (AI).

item.title: In collaboration with Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre, Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority launches My Home is Safe initiative
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority (ADCDA), in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre (ADREC), has launched the My Home is Safe initiative

item.title: In collaboration with Zayed Authority for People of Determination, Abu Dhabi Police launches Sign Language Voice platform to enhance police services for deaf and hearing-impaired people
item.description: Abu Dhabi Police General Headquarters, in collaboration with Zayed Authority for People of Determination, affiliated with the Department of Community Development – Abu Dhabi, has launched the Sign Language Voice platform, a product of the strategic partnership between the two entities.

item.title: Organised by the AgriFood Growth and Water Abundance cluster at Abu Dhabi Investment Office
item.description: The AgriFood Growth and Water Abundance (AGWA) cluster at ADIO convened government leaders, global and regional food companies, investors, regulators and innovators at PALT 2026

item.title: Hazza bin Zayed receives delegation from Abu Dhabi Police, Civil Defence and Crises Management Centre
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hazza bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler’s Representative in Al Ain Region, has received a delegation from Abu Dhabi Police, Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority, and the Emergencies, Crises and Disasters Management Centre – Abu Dhabi.

item.title: 15th United Nations Congress on Crime Prevention and Criminal Justice – Abu Dhabi 2026 takes place in the emirate
item.description: In the presence of Lieutenant General His Highness Sheikh Saif bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior, the 15th United Nations Congress on Crime Prevention and Criminal Justice – Abu Dhabi 2026

item.title: Saif bin Zayed attends 15th United Nations Congress on Crime Prevention and Criminal Justice – Abu Dhabi 2026
item.description: Lieutenant General His Highness Sheikh Saif bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior, has attended part of the proceedings of the 15th United Nations Congress on Crime Prevention and Criminal Justice – Abu Dhabi 2026

item.title: Abu Dhabi Hazardous Materials Management Centre partners with Presight to harness AI for proactive risk management
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Hazardous Materials Management Centre (ADHMMC) and Presight have signed a strategic cooperation agreement to deploy agentic AI solutions across Abu Dhabi’s hazardous materials monitoring and management ecosystem.

item.title: 46th World Congress of Military Medicine – Abu Dhabi 2026 to feature participation of 120+ countries in November
item.description: Organised by the Ministry of Defence in collaboration with ADNEC Group, under the supervision of the International Committee of Military Medicine, Abu Dhabi will host the 46th World Congress of Military Medicine – Abu Dhabi 2026 from 9-13 November at ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Rabdan Academy launches Bachelor of Disaster Management programme, enhancing national preparedness and resilience
item.description: Rabdan Academy has launched its Bachelor of Disaster Management programme, designed to prepare specialised national leaders in disaster and emergency management and help strengthen national preparedness, institutional resilience and business continuity in line with international standards.

item.title: Rabdan Academy hosts Gaming for Good: Online Safety Hackathon
item.description: In collaboration with the Secure Communities Forum of the UAE Ministry of Interior, Rabdan Academy hosted the Gaming for Good: Online Safety Hackathon, supporting the UAE’s broader artificial intelligence agenda

item.title: Mansour bin Zayed reviews Cyber Security Council, Abu Dhabi Police programmes at Sheikh Zayed Summer Festival
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Vice President, Deputy Prime Minister and Chairman of the Presidential Court, visited the pavilions of the UAE Cyber Security Council and Abu Dhabi Police during his tour of the Sheikh Zayed Summer Festival, where he reviewed programmes and interactive workshops designed to enhance students' awareness of security and promote the safe use of modern technologies.

item.title: UAE President commends global humanitarian efforts of UAE Search and Rescue Team
item.description: UAE President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan has received the Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority’s UAE Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) Team.

item.title: Hamdan bin Zayed receives UAE Cyber Security Council delegation and commends establishment of National Cloud's backup data centres in Al Dhafra Region
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Ruler's Representative in Al Dhafra Region, has received a UAE Cyber Security Council delegation, headed by His Excellency Dr Mohamed Al Kuwaiti, Head of Cyber Security for the UAE Government, and commended the establishment of the National Cloud's backup data centres in Al Dhafra Region.

item.title: Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority receives recognition from National Fire Protection Association in US for sustainable fire safety and prevention system
item.description: Abu Dhabi Civil Defence Authority has received international recognition for its efforts in developing a sustainable fire safety and prevention system across Abu Dhabi during its participation in the NFPA Conference & Expo 2026, held in the US.

item.title: Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement and Emirates Council for Balanced Development sign agreement to launch Rawaafid Programme for Defence Industries Micro-Parks
item.description: Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement and Emirates Council for Balanced Development have signed an agreement to launch Rawaafid Programme for Defence Industries Micro-Parks. The initiative aims to develop integrated micro-industrial clusters to support the enablement of the UAE’s national defence industries

item.title: Emergencies, Crises and Disasters Management Centre Abu Dhabi organises training workshop to enhance preparedness in risks
item.description: The Emergencies, Crises and Disasters Management Centre Abu Dhabi (ADCMC), in cooperation with the Abu Dhabi Youth Council, organised a specialised training workshop on the emergency ecosystem.

item.title: In his capacity as Chairman of Abu Dhabi Judicial Department, Mansour bin Zayed issues resolution establishing specialised court for human trafficking crimes
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyanو Chairman of the Presidential Court, in his capacity as Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Judicial Department, has issued Resolution No. 40 of 2026 establishing a specialised court to adjudicate human trafficking crimes in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: ADNEC Group contributes record AED9.2bn+ to UAE economy in 2025
item.description: ADNEC Group, a Modon company, contributed over AED9.2 billion to the UAE economy in 2025, marking its highest economic impact to date and an 8 per cent increase from 2024

item.title: Abu Dhabi Department of Energy annual Safety in Heat campaign reinforces safe working practices across energy sector facilities
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy has launched its annual awareness campaign, Safety in Heat, as part of its ongoing efforts to strengthen health, safety and environmental performance across the energy sector, while supporting a culture of prevention and preparedness.

item.title: Rabdan Academy launches Master of Science in Financial Crime
item.description: Rabdan Academy has announced the launch of its Master of Science in Financial Crime, developed with the support of the General Secretariat of the National Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing Committee.
